Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer accuses Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin of manipulating Donald Trump through diplomatic flattery. As Trump embraces Xi during his China visit and maintains cordial ties with Putin, Schumer warns that the US President is prioritising photo opportunities over American interests, including national security, AI chip restrictions, fentanyl and Russia's war in Ukraine.
